assets.modifications: Twelve clips: boom (0.5 s), small boom (0.3 s), clank (40 ms), thud (80 ms), hiss loop (0.5 s), hum loop (1.0 s), arc crackle (0.5 s), klaxon (three 120 ms square chirps, 0.5 s), growl (70 Hz saw with tremolo, 0.6 s), servo loop (1.2 kHz sine with a 6 Hz vibrato, 1.0 s), winch loop (90 Hz saw with a 7 Hz wobble, 1.0 s) and whine (sine sweep 300 Hz to 1.8 kHz, 0.6 s); added 2026-10-09: servo, winch and whine. assets.implementation_status: In use since 2026-10-08 for the containment gate boom, the relay contact clank and crackle, the seal landing thud, the knockdown thud, the Records exit arc, and in the Service Junction for the breaker clunk, the valve clicks, the hiss and pump hum that follow the gauge, the seal-charged klaxon, WOLF's growl, the relief-vent small boom and the door blast; since 2026-10-09 also the sentry's servo (pitch follows its state and winds down when it goes over), the tank's clamp, landing boom and missed-drop clang, the winch during the arm's rewind, and the exit bolt's whine, arc and clank. Nothing has been ear-tested in a normal window yet; the clips are a first pass.

status: One provisional brand mark, three provisional character images (redrawn 2026-10-08), one title background, three layered gameplay rooms (far, mid and near plates for the corridor, Records Access and the Service Junction), seventeen station props (eight for the corridor and Records Access; eight for the Service Junction plus one documented derivative crop of its tank; the junction reuses the corridor breaker), two sentry images, three derivative marketing captures, the Roboto and Montserrat font families, one generated changelog text export and one procedural sound-effect set (code, no files) recorded; no audio files acquired. Glows, haze, dust, lockdown beacons, reflections, particles, the Service Junction's state overlays (pressure line, gauge needle, turn lights, seam glow, panel and hatch lights, alcove, floor mark, arm rods and cable, the sentry's beam and eye light) and the screen grade are procedural built-in nodes and three small shaders (two files plus the valve wheel's inline disc mask), not image assets.
